text: And it came to pass after the calamity, and the LORD spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, saying,
Take the sum of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years and up, according to the houses of their patrimony! every one ; going forth to deploy among Israel.
And [[6]spoke [1]Moses [2]and [3]Eleazar [4]the [5]priest] with them in the wilderness of Moab at the Jordan by Jericho, saying,
This is the numbering from twenty years and up, in which manner the LORD gave orders to; Moses. And the sons of Israel, the ones coming forth out of Egypt --
and Reuben, was first-born of Israel. And the sons of Reuben -- Hanoch, the people of the of Hanochites; ; of Pallu, the people of the Palluites;
to; Hezron; the people of the Hezronites; to; Carmi, the people of the of Carmites.
These are the peoples of Reuben. And [[4]was [1]the [2]number [3]of them] three and forty thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
And the sons of Pallu -- Eliab;

and the sons of Eliab -- Namuel, and Dathan, and Abiram; these are; the ones summoned of the congregation. These are the ones rising up together against Moses and Aaron in the gathering of Korah, in the conspiring against the LORD.
And [[3]opening [1]the [2]earth] ; its mouth swallowed them and Korah in the death ; of his congregation, when [[3]devoured [1]the [2]fire] the fifty and two hundred. And they were made as a sign.
But the sons of Korah did not die.
And the sons of Simeon the people of the sons of Simeon; to; Nemuel, the people the Nemuelites; to; Jamin, the people the Jaminites; to; Jachin, the people the Jachinites;
to; Zerah, the people the Zerahites; to; Shaul the people the Shaulites.
These are the peoples of Simeon by ; their numbering -- two and twenty thousand and two hundred.
The sons of Gad according to their peoples -- to; Zephon, the people the Zephonites; to; Haggi, the people the Haggites; to; Shuni, the people the Shunites;
to; Ozni, the people the Oznites; to; Eri, the people the Erites;
to; Arod, the people the Arodites; to; Areli, the people the Arelites.
These are the peoples of the sons of Gad by their numbering -- forty thousand and five hundred.
Sons of Judah -- Er and Onan, Shelah, and Pharez and Zara; and [[4]died [1]Er [2]and [3]Onan] in the land of Canaan.
And [[4]were [1]the [2]sons [3]of Judah] according to their peoples -- to; Shelah, the people the Shelanites; to; Pharez, the people the Pharzites; to; Zerah, the people the Zerhites.
And [[4]were [1]the [2]sons [3]of Pharez] -- to; Hezron, the people the Hezronites; to; to Hamul, the people the Hamulites.
These are the peoples to; Judah, according to ; their numbering -- six and seventy thousand and five hundred.
And the sons of Issachar according to their peoples -- to; Tola, the people the Tolaites; to; Pua, the people the Punites;
to; Jashub, the people the Jashubites; to; Shimron, the people the Shimronites.
These are the peoples of Issachar by their numbering -- four and sixty thousand and three hundred.
Sons of Zebulun according to their peoples -- to; Sered, the people the Seredites; to; Elon, the people the Elonites; to; Jahleel, the people the Jahleelites.
These are the peoples of Zebulun by their numbering -- sixty thousand and five hundred.
Sons of Joseph according to their peoples -- Manasseh and Ephraim.
Sons of Manasseh -- to Machir, the people the Machirites; and Machir procreated ; Gilead; to; Gilead, the people the Gileadites;
And these are; sons of Gilead -- to; Jeezer, the people the Jeezerites; to; Helek, the people the Helekites;
to; Asriel, the people the Asrielites; to; Shechem the people the Shechemites;
to; Shemida, the people the Shemidaites; and to; Hepher, the people the Hepherites.
And to; Zelophehad son of Hepher there were no sons to him, only daughters. And these are the names of the daughters of Zelophehad -- Mahlah and Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tizrah.
These are the peoples of Manasseh by their numbering -- two and fifty thousand and seven hundred.
These are the sons of Ephraim -- to; Shuthelah, the people the Shuthelahites; to; Becher, the people the Becherites; to; Tahan, the people the Tahanites.
These are the sons of Shuthelah -- to; Eran, the people the Eranites.
These are the peoples of Ephraim by their numbering -- two and thirty thousand and five hundred. These are the peoples of the sons of Joseph according to their peoples.
Sons of Benjamin according to their peoples -- to; Bela, the people the Belaites; to; Ashbel, the people the Ashbelites; to; Ahiram, the people the Ahiramites;
to Shupham the people the Shuphamites; to; Shupham, the people the Shuphamites.
And were the sons of Bela -- Ard and Naaman. To; Ard, the people the Ardites; to; Naaman, the people the Naamites.
These are; the sons of Benjamin according to their peoples by their numbering -- five and forty thousand and six hundred.
And the sons of Dan according to their peoples -- to; Shuham, the people the Shuhamites. These are the peoples of Dan according to their peoples.
All the peoples of Shuham according to their overseeing -- four and sixty thousand and four hundred.
Sons of Asher according to their peoples -- to; Jimna, the people the Jimnites; to; Jesui, the people the Jesuites; to; Beriah, the people the Beriites;
to; Heber, the people the Heberites; to; Malchiel, the people the Malchielites.
And the name of the daughter of Asher -- Sarah.
These are the peoples of Asher by their numbering -- three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
The sons of Naphtali according to their peoples -- to; Jahzeel, the people the Jahzeelites; to; Guni, the people the Gunites;
to; Jezer, the people the Jezerites; to Shillem, the people the Shillemites.
These are the peoples of Naphtali by their numbering -- five and forty thousand and four hundred.
This is the numbering of the sons of Israel -- six hundred thousand and a thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
To these [[3]shall be portioned [1]the [2]land] to inherit by the number of names.
To the many [[3]will be superabundant [1]the [2]inheritance], and to the less [[2]will be less ; [1]their inheritance]. To each as they are numbered [[2]shall be given ; [1]their inheritance].
By lots [[3]shall be portioned [1]the [2]land] by the names; according to the tribes of their patrimony they shall inherit.
By the lot you shall portion ; their inheritance between the many and few.
And the sons of Levi according to their peoples -- to; Gershon, the people the Gershonites; to; Kohath, the people the Kohathites; to; Merari, the people the Merarites.

These are the peoples of the sons of Levi; the people -- the Libinites; the people -- the Hebronites; the people -- the Mahlites; the people -- the Mushites; and the people -- the Korathites; and Kohath procreated ; Amram.
And the name ; of his wife was Jochebed, daughter of Levi, who bore these ; to Levi in Egypt. And she bore ; to Amram -- ; Aaron and Moses and Miriam ; their sister.
And was born ; to Aaron ; both Nadab, and Abihu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.
And [[4]died [1]Nadab [2]and [3]Abihu] in ; their offering [[2]fire [1]alien] before the LORD; in the wilderness of Sinai.

And there were of their numbering -- three and twenty thousand, every male from a month and up. [[3]not [1]For [2]they were] considered together in the midst of the sons of Israel, for [[2]was not [3]given [4]to them [1]a lot] in the midst of the sons of Israel.
And this ; numbering was by Moses and Eleazar the priest, the ones who numbered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Moab, at the Jordan by Jericho.
And among these there was not a man of the ones being numbered by Moses and Aaron whom they numbered being of the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
For the LORD said to them, By death they shall die in the wilderness, and there shall not be left behind of them not even one, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
